text_block_list.text:
Next day brought unexpected encounter 
with Air Groove. Traced irritated voice 
echoing down hallway―

Air Groove's Trainer: Why! I am Air Groove's trainer! 
Listen to reason…!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Tracen Academy upholds student autonomy. 
Student council duties fall under that purview.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Council work and mentoring juniors 
hinders her personal development! Therefore―

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove acts with clear intent and purpose. 
None may strip that without her consent.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Did Air Groove agree to this rule of 
"resigning council to prioritize training"?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Trainer
text_block_list.text: Th-that is…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ―No. Zero recollection of such agreement.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Trainer
text_block_list.text: Air Groove…! Why are you here?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
President, apologies for entangling you. 
I shall handle this.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Very well. I take my leave. 
…Show some restraint, Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: …I shall endeavor to.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Now then. You have overstepped considerably.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Wait, listen! 
Simply wanted to prevent wasted time…!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Wasted," you say… 
That word alone ends all discussion.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Trainer
text_block_list.text:
What… why! Aiming for peak results 
requires eliminating extraneous tasks!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Peak results… if that encompasses entire vision, 
our philosophies fundamentally diverge.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We are done. Supervisory contract is 
hereby terminated. Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Good grief… happened again, huh?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Doubt many trainers match 
her standards, but still―

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Wait, eyeing Air Groove again? 
Slow learner, aren't you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hm? Hold on, prime opening for you, no?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, step up now and you 
might scout Air Groove yourself.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
She's strict "Empress" though, ensure you're rea― 
Wait, gone already.

Pursued Air Groove to tree-lined path 
to pitch scouting offer. Then―

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Good grief… is that caliber of trainer 
best Tracen offers?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: At this rate, finding trustworthy partner proves―
choice_data_list: Air Groove, I'm here to scout you!
Air Groove, I'm here to scout you!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hah…? Who are you! Materializing 
out of nowhere, how insolent!

Faced with stern glare, introduced myself 
formally and stated scouting intentions…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. Tenacity noted, but I grow 
weary of wasting time on trainers.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: No intention of partnering with novice trai―

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: …No, wait.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Tomorrow, weight training in academy gym. 
I shall permit you to construct menu.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
First, demonstrate competence as trainer. 
Then we deliberate.

Spent entire night crafting regimen 
designed to earn Air Groove's approval.
Following day…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hm. Acceptable. Seems you can 
manage baseline training without disruption.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Terms of contract are thus: As trainer, 
you concern yourself solely with direct training.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Interfering beyond training—namely my time 
dedicated to student council—will not be tolerated.
choice_data_list: So, you'll let me scout you!?
So, you'll let me scout you!?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Do not dare forget 
contractual terms. Now then…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I am "The Empress," Air Groove. I bear this title to stand as an ideal and guiding compass for all Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Naturally, on the turf as well, I must uphold the weight of this name. Delivering nothing less than absolute victory and undeniable results is my solemn duty.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: To that end, ensure you execute your duties as Trainer flawlessly. Is that clear?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What an unreliable answer… Hmph. Well, no matter.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I never intended to rely on you in the first place…
Thus, with a lingering sense of unease, my days of training Air Groove began—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Is that all for today's regimen? Then I shall take my leave.
choice_data_list: Where are you going in such a hurry?
Where are you going in such a hurry?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You have no right to question my personal time, but very well. I am going to oversee the juniors' training.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Students without assigned trainers rely on general instructors, but uniform regimens make tailored guidance difficult.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Many struggle under that framework. I merely offer guidance where I can.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Time is scarce. Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What…? A meeting right this second?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Impossible. Student Council inspection duties are scheduled now. Furthermore, I explicitly told you to submit schedule adjustments twenty-four hours in advance.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Submit documentation of the agenda. I shall review it later.
Merely days after contract signing, her relentless schedule was already a serious concern…
